questions.q: Who was the "wise helper" Gray Brother had brought to help Mowgli?
choices: Akela
Bagheera
Baloo
Kaa

questions.q: How did Mowgli ask the wolves to divide the buffalo herd?
choices: Cows and calves in one group, bulls and plow buffaloes in the other
The oldest buffaloes in one group and the youngest in the other
The fastest runners in one group and the slowest in the other
Rama alone in one group and all the other buffaloes together
questions.evidence: Keep the cows and calves together, and the bulls and the plow buffaloes by themselves.

questions.q: Why were the cow-buffaloes more dangerous than the bulls?
choices: They had calves to protect
They had longer, sharper horns
They were much bigger
They had not eaten yet
questions.evidence: for they had no calves to protect

questions.q: What did the other herd children do when the buffaloes crashed into the thicket?
choices: Ran to the village crying that the buffaloes had gone mad
Climbed the nearest trees to hide from the charging bulls
Followed Mowgli into the jungle to help him drive the herd
Stayed quietly with their cattle and waited for the evening
questions.evidence: crying that the buffaloes had gone mad and run away

questions.q: What was Mowgli's plan for trapping Shere Khan?
choices: Catch him in the ravine between the bulls and the cows
Lead him into a pit trap that the villagers had dug
Drive him out onto the plain where Buldeo could shoot him
Chase him into the river where he would be too slow
questions.evidence: catch Shere Khan between the bulls and the cows

questions.q: Why did it matter that the sides of the ravine ran nearly straight up and down?
choices: Shere Khan would not be able to climb out and escape
The buffaloes would be able to run down it much faster
Mowgli could hide on top without being seen
The echoes would frighten the tiger into running
questions.evidence: would give no foothold to a tiger who wanted to get out

questions.q: Why did Shere Khan run from the herd instead of fighting?
choices: He was heavy with his dinner and his drink
He was still badly burned from the Red Flower
He did not see the buffaloes until it was too late
He hoped Tabaqui would come to his rescue
questions.evidence: heavy with his dinner and his drink, willing to do anything rather than fight

choices: The buffalo herd trampled him in the ravine
Mowgli stabbed him with his knife
Akela and Gray Brother pulled him down together
Buldeo shot him with his old Tower musket
questions.evidence: Shere Khan needed no more trampling. He was dead

questions.q: Why did Buldeo want to singe Shere Khan's whiskers?
choices: To keep the tiger's ghost from haunting him
To prove to the Government that he had killed it
To make the skin easier to take off the body
To keep the whiskers as a lucky charm
questions.evidence: Most native hunters always singe a tiger's whiskers to prevent his ghost from haunting them.

questions.q: What did Buldeo plan to do with Shere Khan's skin?
choices: Take it to Khanhiwara for the hundred-rupee reward
Give it to the priest to hang in the village temple
Keep it on the floor of his own hut as a rug
Sell it to Messua's husband for a good price
questions.evidence: when I have taken the skin to Khanhiwara

questions.q: Why did Buldeo call Mowgli "Great King" while lying on the grass?
choices: He feared Mowgli was a sorcerer who could command wolves
He had learned that Mowgli was the son of a real king
He wanted to trick Mowgli into giving him the skin
He was thanking Mowgli for killing the man-eating tiger
questions.evidence: It was sorcery, magic of the worst kind, thought Buldeo

questions.q: Buldeo "embroidered the story of his adventures." What does "embroidered" mean here?
choices: Added made-up details to make it more exciting
Sewed a picture of the story onto a cloth
Told it very quietly so that no one could hear
Wrote it down carefully in a little book
questions.evidence: Buldeo embroidered the story of his adventures in the jungle

questions.q: What happened when Mowgli brought the buffaloes back to the village gate?
choices: The villagers threw stones and called him a sorcerer
The villagers cheered him for killing the lame tiger
The priest gave him the hundred-rupee reward
Messua's husband locked him inside the hut

questions.q: What did Buldeo's musket shot hit at the village gate?
choices: A young buffalo
Mowgli's shoulder
Akela's back leg
The temple bell
questions.evidence: a young buffalo bellowed in pain

questions.q: What did Messua believe about Mowgli?
choices: He was no sorcerer and had avenged her son Nathoo's death
He really was a wizard who could turn himself into a wolf
He had stolen one of the buffaloes and must be punished
He should stay and let the priest make him a man again
questions.evidence: I know thou hast avenged Nathoo's death

questions.q: Why did Mowgli decide not to hurt the village after he was driven out?
choices: Messua had been kind to him
Akela told him it was against the Law
He was too tired from the long day
He was afraid of Buldeo's musket
questions.evidence: we will not hurt the village, for Messua was kind to me

questions.q: What did Mowgli do with Shere Khan's hide at the Council Rock?
choices: Spread it on Akela's rock and pegged it down
Gave it to Mother Wolf to line the floor of her cave
Buried it beneath the stones of the hill
Wore it over his shoulders like a cloak
questions.evidence: pegged it down with four slivers of bamboo

questions.q: What is this part of the story mostly about?
choices: Mowgli kills Shere Khan, keeps his promise, and is cast out by men and wolves
Mowgli becomes the leader of the Seeonee Pack after the tiger is killed
Buldeo the hunter tracks and shoots Shere Khan for the Government reward
Mowgli makes peace with the villagers and goes on living with Messua
questions.evidence: Man-Pack and Wolf-Pack have cast me out
